resolver_definition.swissprot_transform: Trinotate SwissProt hit to gene symbol; accessions and species suffixes are not submitted
resolver_definition.fallback: none; raw target IDs are retained only in mapping provenance
resolver_definition.portability_filter: symbol-like names only; transcript, contig, seed-ortholog, Ensembl protein and arbitrary accessions excluded
resolver_definition.taxonomy_policy: taxonomy-independent resolver; annotation taxonomy retained as provenance only
resolver_definition.use_trinotate_universe_effect: compatibility metadata only; does not redefine the tested universe
